exposure: frequent vaginal examination (four or more times) during labor and delivery
cohort: The study followed 672 mother-newborn pairs from Gandhi Memorial Hospital.
finding: Frequent digital vaginal examination, prolonged rupture of membranes, induced labor, and gestational age < 37 weeks were significantly associated with an increased risk of early-onset neonatal sepsis.
mod_finding: Frequent vaginal examination during labor and induced labor were found to significantly increase the risk of early-onset neonatal sepsis.
